description: This file contains utility functions for parsing command line arguments and environment variables, specifically for handling flags of various types (string, integer, float, boolean, list) and reading environment variables. It provides a set of abstractions to consume and apply flag options, facilitating command-line interface development.

methods.name: readEnvNumber
methods.description: Reads an environment variable by name, trims it, and parses it as a floating-point number. Returns null if the variable is not set or the value is not a finite number.

methods.name: consumeStringFlag
methods.description: Checks if the argument at the specified index matches a flag and returns the next index and parsed string value, or null if it doesn't match.

methods.name: consumeStringListFlag
methods.description: Checks if the argument at the specified index matches a flag and returns the next index and a string value (if valid), or null if it doesn't match.

methods.name: consumeIntFlag
methods.description: Checks if the argument at the specified index matches a flag, parses the following argument as an integer, and enforces an optional minimum value.

methods.name: consumeFloatFlag
methods.description: Checks if the argument at the specified index matches a flag, parses the following argument as a float, and enforces optional minimum and inclusion options.

methods.name: stringFlag
methods.description: Creates a flag spec for consuming string flags and assigning their value to a target key.

methods.name: stringListFlag
methods.description: Creates a flag spec for consuming string list flags and appending their value to a target list.

methods.name: intFlag
methods.description: Creates a flag spec for consuming integer flags with optional options.

methods.name: floatFlag
methods.description: Creates a flag spec for consuming float flags with optional options.

methods.name: booleanFlag
methods.description: Creates a flag spec for boolean flags that set a key to a specified value when the flag is present.

methods.name: parseFlagArgs
methods.description: Main function to parse command-line arguments based on provided specifications, handling unknown options and double dash continuation.
